open_points.subject: _client_bucket_key
open_points.text: _client_bucket_key: [BEHAVIOR] MUST build the rate-limit key from the canonical path and the client network identity exactly.
open_points.other_text: _client_bucket_key: [BEHAVIOR] MUST take as the client network identity the supplied client_host, which the guard reads only from the host of the connection's client and never from a forwarded header, a client-supplied identity header, a cookie or the capability secret; MUST use the imported VIEWER_ENTRY_CLIENT_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN constant when client_host is absent or empty, and MUST keep only the leading characters of a longer identity, as many as the imported VIEWER_ENTRY_CLIENT_IDENTITY_MAX_CHARACTERS constant allows.
open_points.question: Must the key preserve the supplied client network identity exactly, or must longer identities be truncated; alternatively, clarify that “exactly” refers to using the normalized identity produced by the fallback-and-truncation rule.

open_points.subject: _client_bucket_key
open_points.text: _client_bucket_key: [BEHAVIOR] MUST take as the client network identity the supplied client_host, which the guard reads only from the host of the connection's client and never from a forwarded header, a client-supplied identity header, a cookie or the capability secret; MUST use the imported VIEWER_ENTRY_CLIENT_IDENTITY_UNKNOWN constant when client_host is absent or empty, and MUST keep only the leading characters of a longer identity, as many as the imported VIEWER_ENTRY_CLIENT_IDENTITY_MAX_CHARACTERS constant allows.
open_points.rule: Владелец такой ноты — caller/callsite, не callee.
open_points.question: Move the requirement that the guard obtains client_host only from the connection client to an install_transport_guards note, and leave the _client_bucket_key note responsible only for processing its supplied client_host argument.
